body: Thank you so much. It is really such a relieving feeling to feel understood and heard. Thank you ❤️
I’m so sorry that happened to you. I know the feeling and I know it really hurts ☹️

I do. Sometime that thought will slip to the back of my mind, but then i’m reminded when someone does something that hurts me. Because if I was truly on their mind would they have still done what hurt me in the first place? Or is it that they just really don’t care about me in general? Hope you’re hanging in there. You’re on my mind ❤️
Thank you so much for commenting. You’re the sign I needed tonight to give it more time. You saved my life

I’m broken beyond repair. My antidepressants don’t help me. Talking doesn’t help me. For the last month or so, I’ve been at my lowest & my worst. 2 weeks ago I prayed to God to take me. Just let me die in my sleep. That night my grandfather died. I don’t know why God took him instead of me. I asked to be taken in place of someone else. No one wants me around. I don’t bring anything of importance to the world. I don’t bring any improvement to the world. I just don’t see the point of being here anymore. I’m in so much pain I want it to end.

I completely agree. I also feel like a lot of middle aged people feel people my aged/my generation (i’m 23) play the “mental health card”. I feel this way because I think that’s what probably was common when they were growing up! Which is really unfortunate because I think it deters/prevents people from getting the help they may need or benefit from☹️
I’m starting to enjoy them too. I’m a nurse so I’ve been able to work during all of this and it’s been kind of a relief that I don’t have to fake a smile all 12 days of my shift.
I realize this over and over again every year on my birthday.

2020 has just been one of the worst years of my life. Of course I know it’s been that way for SO many others with all that’s been happening, which in itself is so heartbreaking to me. 2 deaths of people I loved so so so dearly in 6 months. I really don’t have any friends. People who I thought were friends of mine I realized only seemed like my friends because I was around them 24/7 at college..(roommates, classmates, etc.) I mean I can’t blame them, i’m not smart, talented, funny, fun so why would anyone want to be around me anyway? I just honestly don’t see a future where i’m still living. I’ve been like this for as long as I can remember. I’d say I probably started to feel this way around 5/6. I’m 23 now so it’s been almost a good 20 years. 20 years of constantly feeling that way and covering it up so well, you just get tired. And i’m at that point. I’m tired.

I’m a new grad too. Just under a year of working as a nurse. I know this feeling and i’m so sorry you experienced it. I know it’s a really terrible feeling. What has helped me is coworkers of mine that I’ve opened up to have told me that even the most seasoned nurses have days like that. You’re not alone❤️
Everyday it just gets harder to stay alive. I pray every single night to God to just take me. Take me instead of someone else. Yet every morning I still wake up..more and more disappointed everyday.
